_doc: Config Q2 (plan 3) = Q (configs/flow_pure.json: pure model, no rule-read hints / checks) + the learned rule layer: cards written by the model itself (src/lrl_gen.py: rulebook rows compiled at inference, value aliases of the shop's data, loanword spellings, rules induced from TRAINING mistakes and accepted by tests/lrl_accept.py) matched to the question (src/lrl.py) into a # RULES block; a matched card's check that flags the program asks for one repair turn.
